D: A shy, bullied teenager with telekinetic powers is asked to the senior prom.
P: Serve the punch when Tommy asks Carrie to the prom.
S: Devilled eggs, ham and pineapple picks, chive cream cheese on cucumber
Devilled eggs with paprika, leg ham and pineapple chunks on toothpicks, and cucumber rounds piped with cream cheese and chives, on silver trays like a 1970s prom.
Gym class pretzel bites with cheese dip
the girls' gym class at the start

Chewy pretzel bites dipped in hot bicarb water, salted and baked deep brown, with a warm cheddar and mustard cheese dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water and knead 8 minutes, then prove 1 hour. Roll into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Simmer 2 litres water with 60g bicarb, drop the bites in for 20 seconds, drain, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 250ml milk until thick, then melt in 150g grated cheddar and 1 tsp mustard.
Radish roses, cucumber and carrot sticks bunched like a corsage, ranch dip

Radishes cut into roses, cucumber and carrot batons bunched like a corsage, with a ranch dip of buttermilk, sour cream, garlic, dill and chives. Cut radishes into roses and bunch cucumber and carrot batons like a corsage. Mix 100ml buttermilk, 150g sour cream, a crushed garlic clove, dill and chives for ranch.
M: Pan seared chicken breast in white wine mushroom cream, mash and green beans
Chicken breasts browned in butter, finished in a 200C oven, served with a creamy mushroom and white wine sauce, mashed potato and buttered green beans.
Carrie's strict mother and her bare kitchen table

Chicken thighs simmered with carrot, celery and thyme in a creamy broth, topped with fluffy parsley dumplings steamed right on top in the pot. Brown 1kg chicken thighs in a large pot, then add 1 diced onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 1 litre chicken stock and thyme. Simmer covered for 30 minutes and stir in 100ml cream. Mix 200g self-raising flour, 50g grated cold butter, chopped parsley and a pinch of salt with about 120ml milk to a soft dough. Drop 8 spoonfuls on top, cover and simmer for 15 minutes until puffed.
W: Bates High prom queen strawberry cake
Vanilla sponge layers filled with strawberries and whipped cream

Two vanilla sponges baked at 175C, layered with sliced strawberries and whipped cream, covered in pale pink strawberry buttercream, a little sugar crown on top. Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Fill with 250g sliced strawberries and 200ml whipped cream. Cover in pink buttercream of 150g butter, 300g icing sugar and mashed strawberry.
K: A pineapple juice ice ring in lemonade and pineapple juice, with strawberries

Pineapple juice and lemonade with sliced strawberries and orange in a big glass bowl, a ring of frozen juice floating instead of ice so it doesn't water down. Freeze 500ml pineapple juice in a ring tin overnight. Put it in a big glass bowl and pour over 1.25L lemonade and 250ml more pineapple juice. Add sliced strawberries and orange.
